search_window.basis: Start is completed_at of the latest independently fetched preceding Food Line watch heartbeat. Search-engine two-day recency is discovery only; actual publication/event timing and duplicate history govern inclusion. Execution began before nominal hourly schedule timestamp.

coverage_notes: Supplementary recall watch only; production nationwide Food Line collection remains authoritative. Checked four high-value classes: loss of a community's sole/last/full-service grocer, hazard-canceled emergency food distributions, abrupt pantry/food-bank closure/access reduction, and official immediate SNAP/WIC/EBT interruptions.

Twelve targeted web searches completed (fast, two-day recency) with no search failures. No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption first evidenced within the verified bounded window. Search indexing surfaced older or preannounced events; absence of results is not evidence of comprehensive nationwide absence.

Excluded previously recorded Provo, Utah Community Action Services and Food Bank closure candidate, originally captured at 06:50 PDT and pending review. No new direct-provider confirmation in this watch.

Excluded older reports: Spencer, New York sole-grocery fire September 11; Stockton, Alabama distribution weather cancellation October 10; El Paso food-bank storm closure September 25; and San Jose food pantry zoning threat reported October 3 without newly documented service shutdown.

Townsend, Wisconsin Mike's Super Market was identified as the only local grocery with planned closure October 31, but the sourced report was dated October 19; no new announcement or actual closing time within the hourly window was established. Treated as an older preannounced event, not a fresh qualifying signal.

Excluded October 2025 federal SNAP shutdown stories, which do not establish a new October 2026 official interruption. Routine EBT rules, holiday closures, donation/promotional material, and non-U.S. reports were not candidates.
